example.en: Hou Yi lifted his head and looked up.
Hou Yi shot down nine suns.
She gazed at the moon in the sky.

simp.text: 那天晚上的月亮，又大又圆。

trad.text: 那天晚上的月亮，又大又圓。
trad.bpmf: 那天晚上的月亮，又大又圓。

example.en: The moon that night was big and round.

simp.text: 他翻过一座又一座高山。

trad.text: 他翻過一座又一座高山。
trad.bpmf: 他翻過一󠇡座又一󠇡座高山。

example.en: He climbed over one high mountain after another.
He wore through several pairs of shoes.
She tried to grab the table but could not hold on.
The house was completely silent.
She floated past layer upon layer of white clouds.

simp.text: 眼泪一颗一颗掉了下来。

trad.text: 眼淚一顆一顆掉了下來。
trad.bpmf: 眼淚一󠇢顆一󠇢顆掉了下來。

example.en: Tears fell from his eyes drop by drop.

simp.text: 在这一夜摆上圆饼与水果。

trad.text: 在這一夜擺上圓餅與水果。
trad.bpmf: 在這一󠇡夜擺上圓餅與水果。

example.en: On this night they set out round cakes and fruit.

simp.text: 嫦娥最爱吃圆圆的甜饼。

trad.text: 嫦娥最愛吃圓圓的甜餅。
trad.bpmf: 嫦娥最愛吃圓圓的甜餅。

example.en: Chang'e loved to eat round sweet cakes most of all.
Later it came to be called the mooncake.

simp.text: 身边只有一只小玉兔陪著她。

trad.text: 身邊只有一隻小玉兔陪著她。
trad.bpmf: 身邊只有一󠇢隻小玉兔陪著她。

example.en: Only a little Jade Rabbit stayed by her side.
He was so frightened that he dropped his sword.

vocab.en: the Mid-Autumn Festival, held on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month, when families gather to admire the full moon and eat mooncakes

simp.text: 这个日子就变成了我们现在所说的中秋节。

trad.text: 這個日子就變成了我們現在所說的中秋節。
trad.bpmf: 這個󠇡日子󠇡就變成了我們現在所說的中秋節。

example.en: This day became what we now call the Mid-Autumn Festival.

vocab.en: elixir of immortality, an immortal's pill

example.en: In her hand she had a kind of elixir of immortality.
She had originally been a fairy in heaven.
Now she had become an ordinary mortal.

vocab.en: to respect, to hold in esteem

example.en: Everyone in the village respected him.

simp.text: 望著天上的月亮，悄悄地叹气。

trad.text: 望著天上的月亮，悄悄地嘆氣。
trad.bpmf: 望著天上的月亮，悄悄地󠇡嘆氣。

example.en: She gazed at the moon in the sky and quietly sighed.
Feng Meng pretended to have a stomachache.
Then something wondrous happened.

simp.text: 这一天，正好是农历八月十五。

trad.text: 這一天，正好是農曆八月十五。
trad.bpmf: 這一󠇢天，正好是農曆八月十五。

example.en: That day happened to be the fifteenth of the eighth lunar month.

vocab.en: to admire the moon, a Mid-Autumn custom

simp.text: 大家都记得在这晚一家人聚在一起赏月。

trad.text: 大家都記得在這晚一家人聚在一起賞月。
trad.bpmf: 大家都記得󠇡在這晚一󠇢家人聚在一󠇢起賞月。

example.en: Everyone remembers to gather as a family on this night to admire the moon.

simp.text: 就像一家人团圆地聚在一起。

trad.text: 就像一家人團圓地聚在一起。
trad.bpmf: 就像一󠇢家人團圓地󠇡聚在一󠇢起。

example.en: Just as a family reunites and gathers together.

vocab.en: longing, to miss someone far away

example.en: They spoke the longing hidden in their hearts.

vocab.en: to be unwilling to part with something or someone

example.en: She could not bear to fly too far away.

vocab.en: to live forever and never grow old. An idiom for eternal life

example.en: Whoever ate it could live forever and never grow old.

vocab.en: exactly alike. An idiom, literally 'one mould, one pattern'

simp.text: 那身影，竟然和嫦娥一模一样。

trad.text: 那身影，竟然和嫦娥一模一樣。
trad.bpmf: 那身影，竟然和嫦娥一󠇢模一󠇡樣。

example.en: That figure looked exactly like Chang'e.
